# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 15 years old by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v2 c21 P65](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0065)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c29 P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Servant and housekeeper for Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v2 c21 P65](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0065)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v2 c21 P65](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0065)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda is a small, energetic girl with a freckled face, a snub nose, and an exceptionally wide mouth that stretches from ear to ear. She has long, fair hair braids that she ties with enormous, bright blue ribbon bows. As she grows older, she styles her hair into a massive pompadour, though her freckles, snub nose, and broad smile remain unchanged.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Belinda is cheerful, industrious, and fiercely loyal to her mistress, Rosalind Penrose. She possesses a lively sense of humor, a knack for dramatizing situations, and a pragmatic outlook on household work. Although she is occasionally prone to anxiety about domestic accidents or superstitious omens, her devotion to those she cares for is deep and unwavering.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P65](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0065), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v2 c23 P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), [v2 c23 P22](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0022)_

## History

Belinda was hired at age fourteen to serve as the housemaid for Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage, taking the place of her older sisters who had previously held the same role. She quickly developed an intense devotion to Miss Rosalind and adapted enthusiastically to the imaginative life at Echo Cottage, forming a warm friendship with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. She assisted during the famous night when Nell and Isolde accidentally jumped onto old Miss Lavinia Pembroke's bed in the dark. Later, Belinda tried to defend Miss Rosalind's reputation when old Miss Lavinia was furious, admitting that the jump was Nell's idea. When Miss Rosalind reconciled with her former lover, Stephen Stanhope, Belinda loyally kept their secret and helped prepare for the wedding. Following Miss Rosalind's marriage to Mr. Stanhope, Belinda moved with them to Boston. She eventually married a bricklayer named Tom, though she continued her service to Miss Rosalind and visited St. Brendan's Island during the summers.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c23 P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), [v2 c29 P8](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Real name is Leonora Bowman
- Fourth daughter in her family to serve Miss Rosalind Penrose, hence named 'Belinda the Fourth'
- Hired at the age of fourteen to work for board, lodging, and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P65](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0065)</sub>
- Married Tom, a bricklayer, and relocated to the United States

## Quotes

> I do not believe that is the case, Miss Harcourt, ma’am. Visiting is something Miss Rosalind detests.  <sub>[v2 c21 P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048)</sub>

> It’s my hope he weds Miss Rosalind. Certain women are meant to be spinsters right from the beginning, and I fear I belong to that group, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, on account of having precious little tolerance for men.  <sub>[v2 c21 P65](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0065)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, his arm is wrapped around her waist. She wouldn't ever permit it unless he has proposed to her.  <sub>[v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070)</sub>

> Everything’s ready, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, and nothing dreadful has happened yet. Ma’am, the rice bags can be found in the pantry, the worn shoes sit behind the door, and the whipping cream has been placed on the sullar steps.  <sub>[v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
